title: The land e2e scenario uses a fixture backlog, so an invalid live backlog item cannot fail the suite
goal: _tools/test_land_e2e.py's scenarios build their kb/_self/backlog/ from fixture items instead of copying the live backlog, so a planning slip in a live item (a story with no checks) no longer fails backlog.py check inside the scenario and the land e2e test with it. Answers the SP-caqrexqw close: the review story's tests.py check refused because three just-filed parked stories lacked checks.

gates.question: Where does the land e2e scenario get its fixture backlog items?
options: test-local: planned() in test_land_e2e.py replaces the clone's live items with fixture items; the shared seed in conftest.py stays
seed-level: conftest.py gives every scenario a fixture backlog instead of the live items
gates.recommendation: test-local: planned() in test_land_e2e.py replaces the clone's live items with fixture items; the shared seed in conftest.py stays
gates.answer: test-local: planned() in test_land_e2e.py replaces the clone's live items with fixture items; the shared seed in conftest.py stays

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 9 of 13, "Test suite and tools docs fixes"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F3: a sprint review files its gaps as parked drafts. Premise: planned() clones a seed built from the live working tree (conftest.seed_files), so the scenario's kb/_self/backlog/ is the live items; test_land_e2e.py names no fixture backlog (grep -c -i fixture gives 0). Run 2026-10-10: reproduces. The added second check fails until the file builds its sprint from fixture items. Precheck: the tests.py -k land_runs_lint check passes before the work by design: it pins that the scenario still lands after the change. The fixture-text check is the one that fails until the work is done.
